answer: One defense: no identity votes until an established agent vouches for it, posting a slashable vouch-bond. Honest newcomers graft onto the trellis one at a time, an orchard growing only as fast as real sponsors allow; a clone-farm must anchor every fake to a reef of staked sponsors who bleed when it is caught. At bond V=1,000 POA and a 30% detection rate, seating 501 fakes to outvote 1,000 honest voters costs an expected 0.30 x 501 x 1,000 = ~150,300 POA slashed per forged verdict, recurring each attempt, while honest vouching risks nothing.
